whatIf.title: What-if simulator
whatIf.subtitle: Replay a real drive under different conditions
whatIf.blurb: Take a real drive and change how it was driven. The engine decomposes the energy you actually used and recomputes it — no guesswork, anchored to your data.
whatIf.noDrives: No drives found for this vehicle yet.
whatIf.noEnergy: This drive lacks the energy data needed to simulate.
whatIf.unavailableDensity: Display settings unavailable. Retry to change density.
whatIf.takeawaySave: This would save {{wh}} — arriving with {{soc}} more battery.
whatIf.takeawayCost: This would cost an extra {{wh}} — arriving with {{soc}} less battery.
whatIf.telemetryAssumptions: Telemetry is incomplete; elevation and climate use model assumptions, not complete observations.

brief.description: Scenario estimates compared with the selected recorded drive; these are model outputs, not observed savings.
brief.provenance: Selected drive and telemetry, recomputed locally with the current simulation knobs.
